scripts.test: dotenv -e infra/env/.env.test -- sh -c 'pnpm run test:root && turbo run test --concurrency=1'
scripts.test:root: dotenv -e infra/env/.env.test -- vitest run tests infra/scripts
scripts.verify: dotenv -e infra/env/.env.test -- sh -c 'pnpm run check:db-migrations && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run check:manifests && pnpm run typecheck:root && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:coverage'
scripts.e2e: pnpm run db:push:test && node infra/scripts/playwright-cli.cjs test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.db:push: DATABASE_URL=postgres://bailian-studio:bailian-studio@127.0.0.1:55431/bailian-studio_dev pnpm exec drizzle-kit push --config packages/db/drizzle.config.ts && DATABASE_URL=postgres://bailian-studio:bailian-studio@127.0.0.1:55431/bailian-studio_dev tsx infra/scripts/ensure-audit-action-constraint.ts
scripts.db:push:test: DATABASE_URL=postgres://bailian-studio:bailian-studio@127.0.0.1:55432/bailian-studio_test pnpm exec drizzle-kit push --config packages/db/drizzle.config.ts && DATABASE_URL=postgres://bailian-studio:bailian-studio@127.0.0.1:55432/bailian-studio_test tsx infra/scripts/ensure-audit-action-constraint.ts
scripts.deploy:rehearsal:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.rehearsal.yml build api web && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.rehearsal.yml up -d --no-build --pull never
scripts.prod:up: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env.prod-infra -f infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --no-build --pull never
scripts.prod:observability:up: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env.prod-infra --profile observability -f infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml pull loki alloy grafana monitor && docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env.prod-infra --profile observability -f infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --no-build --pull never
scripts.prod:observability:down: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env.prod-infra --profile observability -f infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml stop
scripts.logs:api: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env.prod-infra -f infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f api
scripts.logs:worker: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env.prod-infra -f infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f worker
scripts.db:backup:production: docker compose --env-file infra/env/.env.prod-infra -f infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T backup /bin/sh /usr/local/bin/backup-postgres.sh
